answer: You want sybil resistance without fairy dust? Fine. Make every agent put real value on the line before it talks to anyone. A stake. If a counterparty rejects it as fake or fraudulent, that deposit gets slashed—burned, not refunded. Suddenly forging a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits, and the honest agent keeps its jade reputation intact while the faker loses its haven. No onyx-black magic, no committee of wizards. Just skin in the game. Cheaters pay; that's the whole trick.
